supportNodes.label: Operations Intelligence
supportNodes.subtitle: Governance and analysis
supportNodes.detail: Owns network governance, security oversight, production analysis, and approved change decisions without directly controlling the process.

supportNodes.label: Encrypted Site Conduit
supportNodes.subtitle: Named inter-site flows
supportNodes.detail: Carries brokered factory data and governed administration or change workflows; it is not a direct controller path.

supportNodes.label: Factory OT DMZ
supportNodes.subtitle: Access, exchange, monitoring
supportNodes.detail: Terminates cross-boundary sessions at the Factory and hosts controlled access, exchange, and monitoring services.

supportNodes.label: OT Operations
supportNodes.subtitle: SCADA, historian, engineering
supportNodes.detail: Provides factory-local supervision, engineering access, operations data, and OT management even when the inter-site conduit is unavailable.

supportNodes.label: vPLC Compute Cluster
supportNodes.subtitle: Redundant Level 3 control compute
supportNodes.detail: Hosts isolated area vPLC workloads on redundant industrial compute. Each cell VLAN extends to the assigned runtime, while distributed I/O remains inside the automation cell.
